join_algorithm.description: Specifies which JOIN algorithm is used.

join_output_by_rowlist_perkey_rows_thres.description: The lower limit of per-key average rows in the right table to determine whether to output by row list in hash join.

join_runtime_bloom_filter_bytes.description: Size in bytes of a bloom filter used as JOIN runtime filter (see enable_join_runtime_filters setting).

join_runtime_bloom_filter_hash_functions.description: Number of hash functions in a bloom filter used as JOIN runtime filter (see enable_join_runtime_filters setting).

join_runtime_bloom_filter_max_ratio_of_s.description: If the number of set bits in a runtime bloom filter exceeds this ratio the filter is completely disabled to reduce the overhead.

join_runtime_filter_blocks_to_skip_befor.description: Number of blocks that are skipped before trying to dynamically re-enable a runtime filter that previously was disabled due to poor filtering ratio.

join_runtime_filter_exact_values_limit.description: Maximum number of elements in runtime filter that are stored as is in a set, when this threshold is exceeded it switches to bloom filter.

join_runtime_filter_from_fixed_hash_tabl.description: When the hash join build side was converted to a FixedHashMap (see enable_join_fixed_hash_table_conversion), use that hash map directly as the runtime filter.

join_runtime_filter_min_probe_rows.description: If, at query planning time, the probe side of a JOIN is estimated to produce no more than this number of rows, the JOIN runtime filter is not created.

join_runtime_filter_pass_ratio_threshold.description: If ratio of passed rows to checked rows is greater than this threshold the runtime filter is considered as poorly performing and is disabled for the next join_runtime_filter_blocks_to_skip_before_reenabling blocks to reduce the overhead.

join_runtime_filter_size_from_hash_table.description: Use hash table size statistics collected from previous executions to size the JOIN runtime filter.

join_to_sort_maximum_table_rows.description: The maximum number of rows in the right table to determine whether to rerange the right table by key in left or inner join.

join_to_sort_minimum_perkey_rows.description: The lower limit of per-key average rows in the right table to determine whether to rerange the right table by key in left or inner join.

joined_block_split_single_row.description: Allow to chunk hash join result by rows corresponding to single row from left table.

json_type_escape_dots_in_keys.description: Add new setting that allows to escape dots in JSON keys during JSON type parsing

keeper_max_retries.description: Max retries for general keeper operations

keeper_retry_initial_backoff_ms.description: Initial backoff timeout for general keeper operations

keeper_retry_max_backoff_ms.description: Max backoff timeout for general keeper operations

least_greatest_legacy_null_behavior.description: If enabled, functions 'least' and 'greatest' return NULL if one of their arguments is NULL.

legacy_column_name_of_tuple_literal.description: List all names of element of large tuple literals in their column names instead of hash.

lightweight_delete_mode.description: A mode of internal update query that is executed as a part of lightweight delete.

lightweight_deletes_sync.description: The same as mutations_sync, but controls only execution of lightweight deletes.

limit.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to get from the query result.

log_processors_profiles.description: Write time that processor spent during execution/waiting for data to system.processors_profile_log table.

low_priority_query_wait_time_ms.description: When the query prioritization mechanism is employed (see setting priority), low-priority queries wait for higher-priority queries to finish.

materialize_skip_indexes_on_insert.description: If INSERTs build and store skip indexes.

materialize_statistics_on_insert.description: If statistics are build and materialized for newly inserted parts.

materialize_statistics_on_insert_max_tab.description: Only build and store column statistics for newly inserted parts (see materialize_statistics_on_insert) for tables whose current size plus the block being written, does not exceed this value.

materialized_views_squash_parallel_inser.description: Squash inserts to materialized views destination table of a single INSERT query from parallel inserts to reduce amount of generated parts.

max_autoincrement_series.description: The limit on the number of series created by the generateSerialID function.

max_bytes_before_external_group_by.description: Cloud default value: half the memory amount per replica.

max_bytes_before_external_join.description: If set to a non-zero value and join_algorithm is hash, parallel_hash, default, or auto, the hash join will automatically be converted to grace hash join to enable spilling to disk when the right-side data exceeds this many bytes.

max_bytes_before_external_sort.description: Cloud default value: half the memory amount per replica.

max_bytes_for_lazy_final.description: Maximum number of bytes in the set for lazy FINAL optimization.

max_bytes_ratio_before_external_group_by.description: The ratio of available memory that is allowed for GROUP BY.

max_bytes_ratio_before_external_join.description: The ratio of available memory that is allowed for JOIN.

max_bytes_ratio_before_external_sort.description: The ratio of available memory that is allowed for ORDER BY.

max_consume_snapshots.description: Maximum number of Paimon snapshots to consume per incremental read.

max_dynamic_subcolumns_in_json_type_pars.description: Add a new setting to limit number of dynamic subcolumns during JSON type parsing regardless the parameters specified in the data type

max_estimated_execution_time.description: Maximum query estimate execution time in seconds.

max_insert_block_size_bytes.description: The maximum size of blocks (in bytes) to form for insertion into a table.

max_insert_threads.description: The maximum number of threads to execute the INSERT query.

max_insert_threads_min_free_memory_per_t.description: Same as max_threads_min_free_memory_per_thread, but applied to max_insert_threads instead of max_threads.

max_joined_block_size_bytes.description: Maximum block size in bytes for JOIN result (if join algorithm supports it).

max_limit_for_vector_search_queries.description: SELECT queries with LIMIT bigger than this setting cannot use vector similarity indices.

max_memory_usage.description: Cloud default value: depends on the amount of RAM on the replica.

max_number_of_partitions_for_independent.description: Maximal number of partitions in table to apply independent DISTINCT per partition.
Maximal number of partitions in table to apply independent evaluation of window functions per partition.

max_os_cpu_wait_time_ratio_to_throw.description: Max ratio between OS CPU wait (OSCPUWaitMicroseconds metric) and busy (OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds metric) times to consider rejecting queries.

max_parallel_replicas.description: The maximum number of replicas for each shard when executing a query.

max_parser_backtracks.description: Maximum parser backtracking (how many times it tries different alternatives in the recursive descend parsing process).

max_parsing_threads.description: The maximum number of threads to parse data in input formats that support parallel parsing.

max_partitions_per_insert_block.description: Limits the maximum number of partitions in a single inserted block and an exception is thrown if the block contains too many partitions.

max_parts_to_move.description: Limit the number of parts that can be moved in one query.

max_projection_rows_to_use_projection_in.description: If the number of rows to read from the projection index is less than or equal to this threshold, ClickHouse will try to apply the projection index during query execution.

max_rand_distribution_parameter.description: Maximum value for distribution shape parameters in random distribution functions such as randChiSquared, randStudentT, and randFisherF.

max_rand_distribution_trials.description: Maximum number of trials allowed for random distribution functions such as randBinomial and randNegativeBinomial.

max_recursive_cte_evaluation_depth.description: Maximum limit on recursive CTE evaluation depth

max_reverse_dictionary_lookup_cache_size.description: Maximum size in bytes of the per-query reverse dictionary lookup cache used by the function dictGetKeys.

max_rows_for_lazy_final.description: Maximum number of rows in the set for lazy FINAL optimization.

max_rows_in_set_to_optimize_join.description: Maximal size of the set to filter joined tables by each other's row sets before joining.

max_size_to_preallocate_for_aggregation.description: For how many elements it is allowed to preallocate space in all hash tables in total before aggregation

max_size_to_preallocate_for_joins.description: For how many elements it is allowed to preallocate space in all hash tables in total before join

max_skip_unavailable_shards_num.description: When skip_unavailable_shards is enabled, limits the maximum number of shards that can be silently skipped.

max_skip_unavailable_shards_ratio.description: When skip_unavailable_shards is enabled, limits the maximum ratio (0 to 1) of shards that can be silently skipped.

max_streams_for_files_processing_in_clus.description: If is not zero, limit the number of threads reading data from files in *Cluster table functions.

max_streams_for_union_step.description: Limits the number of simultaneously active data streams in a UNION step (applies to UNION ALL, to UNION DISTINCT, because it is implemented via a UNION ALL step followed by a DISTINCT step, and to a Merge table read with plan-based parallel replicas, which is expanded into a unio

max_streams_for_union_step_to_max_thread.description: This ratio multiplied by max_threads determines a limit on simultaneously active streams in a UNION step (applies to both UNION ALL and UNION DISTINCT).

max_threads.description: The maximum number of query processing threads, excluding threads for retrieving data from remote servers (see the 'max_distributed_connections' parameter).

max_threads_min_free_memory_per_thread.description: Lowers max_threads when the server is under memory pressure, to avoid starting highly-parallel queries that are likely to hit the memory limit.

max_wkb_geometry_elements.description: Maximum number of points, rings, or polygons allowed in a single WKB geometry element during parsing by readWKB and related functions.

memory_overcommit_ratio_denominator.description: It represents the soft memory limit when the hard limit is reached on the global level.

memory_overcommit_ratio_denominator_for_.description: It represents the soft memory limit when the hard limit is reached on the user level.

merge_table_max_tables_to_look_for_schem.description: When creating a Merge table without an explicit schema or when using the merge table function, infer schema as a union of not more than the specified number of matching tables.

merge_tree_generic_exclusion_search_max_.description: When a filter cannot be evaluated as a single continuous range of the primary key, for example when it uses key columns other than the first one, ClickHouse runs an iterative generic exclusion search algorithm over the index marks.

merge_tree_min_bytes_for_concurrent_read.description: The minimum number of bytes to read from one file before MergeTree engine can parallelize reading, when reading from remote filesystem.

merge_tree_min_bytes_per_read_stream.description: Per-stream overhead cost expressed as byte-equivalent.

merge_tree_min_bytes_per_task_for_remote.description: Min bytes to read per task.

merge_tree_min_read_task_size.description: Hard lower limit on the task size (even when the number of granules is low and the number of available threads is high we won't allocate smaller tasks

merge_tree_min_rows_for_concurrent_read_.description: The minimum number of lines to read from one file before the MergeTree engine can parallelize reading, when reading from remote filesystem.

merge_tree_prefetch_json_shared_data_sub.description: Enables prefetching of JSON shared data substreams in Wide parts that are read by seeking to a mark.

merge_tree_read_split_ranges_into_inters.description: For testing of PartsSplitter - split read ranges into intersecting and non intersecting every time you read from MergeTree with the specified probability.

merge_tree_storage_snapshot_sleep_ms.description: Inject artificial delay (in milliseconds) when creating a storage snapshot for MergeTree tables.

merge_tree_use_deserialization_prefixes_.description: Enables caching of columns metadata from the file prefixes during reading from remote disks in MergeTree.

merge_tree_use_prefixes_deserialization_.description: Enables usage of the thread pool for parallel prefixes reading in Wide parts in MergeTree.

merge_tree_use_v1_object_and_dynamic_ser.description: When enabled, V1 serialization version of JSON and Dynamic types will be used in MergeTree instead of V2.

min_count_to_compile_regular_expression.description: Minimum count of executing same regular expression before it is get compiled.

min_external_table_block_size_bytes.description: Squash blocks passed to the external table to a specified size in bytes, if blocks are not big enough.

min_external_table_block_size_rows.description: Squash blocks passed to external table to specified size in rows, if blocks are not big enough.

min_filtered_ratio_for_lazy_final.description: Minimum ratio of marks filtered by index analysis for lazy FINAL optimization.

min_free_disk_bytes_to_perform_insert.description: Minimum free disk space bytes to perform an insert.

min_free_disk_ratio_to_perform_insert.description: Minimum free disk space ratio to perform an insert.

min_joined_block_size_bytes.description: Minimum block size in bytes for JOIN input and output blocks (if join algorithm supports it).

min_joined_block_size_rows.description: Minimum block size in rows for JOIN input and output blocks (if join algorithm supports it).

min_os_cpu_wait_time_ratio_to_throw.description: Min ratio between OS CPU wait (OSCPUWaitMicroseconds metric) and busy (OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds metric) times to consider rejecting queries.

min_outstreams_per_resize_after_split.description: Specifies the minimum number of output streams of a Resize or StrictResize processor after the split is performed during pipeline generation.

min_rows_ratio_for_hash_join_row_store.description: Minimum estimated ratio of join output rows to build-side rows to enable transforming hash join payload to row-major.

min_table_rows_to_use_projection_index.description: If the estimated number of rows to read from the table is greater than or equal to this threshold, ClickHouse will try to use the projection index during query execution.

mongodb_throw_on_unsupported_query.description: If enabled, MongoDB tables will return an error when a MongoDB query cannot be built.

mysql_datatypes_support_level.description: Defines how MySQL types are converted to corresponding ClickHouse types.

mysql_map_fixed_string_to_text_in_show_c.description: When enabled, FixedString ClickHouse data type will be displayed as TEXT in SHOW COLUMNS.

mysql_map_string_to_text_in_show_columns.description: When enabled, String ClickHouse data type will be displayed as TEXT in SHOW COLUMNS.

normalize_function_names.description: Normalize function names to their canonical names

offset.description: Sets the number of rows to skip before starting to return rows from the query.

opentelemetry_start_keeper_trace_probabi.description: Probability to start a trace for ZooKeeper request - whether there is a parent trace or not.

opentelemetry_trace_cpu_scheduling.description: Collect OpenTelemetry spans for workload preemptive CPU scheduling.

optimize_aggregation_in_order_limit.description: When enabled and aggregation in order is active, pushes LIMIT into the aggregation step to enable early termination after producing enough groups.

optimize_and_compare_chain.description: Populate constant comparison in AND chains to enhance filtering ability.

optimize_and_compare_chain_max_hash_work.description: Work budget for the optimize_and_compare_chain optimization during query analysis, measured in the number of query-tree nodes hashed by getTreeHash (the dominant cost of this optimization).

optimize_const_name_size.description: Replace with scalar and use hash as a name for large constants (size is estimated by the name length).

optimize_dictget_tuple_element.description: Rewrite tupleElement(dictGet('dict', ('a', 'b', 'c'), key), 2) into dictGet('dict', 'b', key) to avoid fetching unnecessary dictionary attributes.

optimize_duplicate_order_by_and_distinct.description: Remove duplicate ORDER BY and DISTINCT if it's possible

optimize_empty_string_comparisons.description: Convert expressions like col = '' or '' = col into empty(col), and col != '' or '' != col into notEmpty(col), only when col is of String or FixedString type.

optimize_extract_common_expressions.description: Allow extracting common expressions from disjunctions in WHERE, PREWHERE, ON, HAVING and QUALIFY expressions.

optimize_functions_to_subcolumns.description: Enables or disables optimization by transforming some functions to reading subcolumns.

optimize_group_by_constant_keys.description: Optimize GROUP BY when all keys in block are constant

optimize_injective_functions_in_group_by.description: Replaces injective functions by it's arguments in GROUP BY section

optimize_injective_functions_in_limit_by.description: Replaces injective functions by their arguments in LIMIT BY section.

optimize_inverse_dictionary_lookup.description: Avoid repeated inverse dictionary lookup by doing faster lookups into a precomputed set of possible key values.

optimize_limit_by_function_keys.description: Eliminates functions of other keys in LIMIT BY section.

optimize_move_to_prewhere.description: Enables or disables automatic PREWHERE optimization in SELECT queries.

optimize_mutations_with_partition_prunin.description: When enabled, ClickHouse automatically detects partition key conditions in the WHERE clause of ALTER TABLE UPDATE/DELETE mutations and lightweight UPDATE/DELETE statements on tables of the ReplicatedMergeTree family and only processes the affected partitions instead of all partit

optimize_normalize_count_variants.description: Rewrite aggregate functions that semantically equals to count() as count().

optimize_on_insert.description: Enables or disables data transformation before the insertion, as if merge was done on this block (according to table engine).

optimize_or_like_chain.description: Optimize multiple OR LIKE/ILIKE/match predicates on the same expression into a single multiSearchAny/multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitiveUTF8 (for pure-substring %needle% patterns) or multiMatchAny (for other patterns, when Hyperscan/Vectorscan is permitted).

optimize_or_like_chain_min_patterns.description: Minimum number of non-pure-substring LIKE/ILIKE/match branches (prefix/suffix/regexp patterns), sharing the same left-hand-side expression, required for optimize_or_like_chain to rewrite a chain into multiMatchAny.

optimize_or_like_chain_min_substrings.description: Minimum number of pure-substring (%needle%) LIKE/ILIKE branches, sharing the same left-hand-side expression, required for optimize_or_like_chain to rewrite a chain into multiSearchAny/multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitiveUTF8.

optimize_prewhere_after_pushdown.description: Run a second PREWHERE promotion pass after later query plan optimizations may have deposited additional filters above a MergeTree read step (e.g.

optimize_qbit_distance_function_reads.description: Replace distance functions on QBit data type with equivalent ones that only read the columns necessary for the calculation from the storage.

optimize_read_in_order.description: Enables ORDER BY optimization in SELECT queries for reading data from MergeTree tables.

optimize_redundant_comparisons.description: Detect conflicting and redundant comparison conditions on the same expression within AND chains.

optimize_rewrite_array_exists_to_has.description: Rewrite arrayExists() functions to has() when logically equivalent.

optimize_rewrite_has_to_in.description: Rewrite has functions to IN when the first argument is a constant array.

optimize_rewrite_like_perfect_affix.description: Rewrite LIKE expressions with perfect prefix or suffix (e.g.

optimize_rewrite_regexp_functions.description: Rewrite regular expression related functions into simpler and more efficient forms

optimize_rewrite_sum_if_to_count_if.description: Rewrite sumIf() and sum(if()) function countIf() function when logically equivalent

optimize_syntax_fuse_functions.description: Enables to fuse aggregate functions with identical argument.

optimize_time_filter_with_preimage.description: Optimize Date and DateTime predicates by converting functions into equivalent comparisons without conversions (e.g.

optimize_trivial_count_with_sparsity_fil.description: Extends the optimize_trivial_count_query optimization to queries of the form SELECT count() FROM t WHERE col <op> const, where <op> const exactly partitions rows into defaults and non-defaults of col.

optimize_trivial_group_by_limit_query.description: Enables or disables the optimization of a trivial query SELECT key_expr FROM table GROUP BY key_expr LIMIT n (with no aggregate functions, window functions or arrayJoin in the projection, no HAVING/ORDER BY/QUALIFY/LIMIT BY/DISTINCT/window clauses, and no GROUP BY modifiers) by s

optimize_trivial_view_pushdown_to_distri.description: When enabled, for views over Distributed tables whose SELECT list contains only column references, *, or expressions (but no window functions or scalar subqueries), and that have no aggregation, grouping, ordering, or joins, the full outer query is pushed to each shard.

optimize_truncate_order_by_after_group_b.description: Remove trailing ORDER BY elements once all GROUP BY keys are covered in the ORDER BY prefix.

optimize_use_projection_filtering.description: Enables using projections to filter part ranges even when projections are not selected to perform SELECT query.

order.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause to the query as a wrapping subquery.

os_threads_nice_value_materialized_view.description: Linux nice value for materialized view threads.

os_threads_nice_value_query.description: Linux nice value for query processing threads.

output_format.description: Overrides the output format of the query.

output_format_always_write_decimal_point.description: New setting to always print a decimal point for floating-point and Decimal numbers in text formats, even when the value is a whole number.

output_format_arrow_compression_method.description: Use lz4 compression in Arrow output format by default

output_format_arrow_date_as_uint16.description: Write Date as Arrow DATE32 instead of plain UInt16 by default.

output_format_arrow_fixed_string_as_fixe.description: Use Arrow FIXED_SIZE_BINARY type for FixedString by default

output_format_arrow_string_as_string.description: ClickHouse allows arbitrary binary data in the String data type, which is typically UTF-8.

output_format_arrow_unsupported_types_as.description: New setting to convert unsupported CH types to arrow binary instead of UNKNOWN_TYPE exception.

output_format_arrow_use_64_bit_indexes_f.description: Allow to use 64 bit indexes type in Arrow dictionaries

output_format_arrow_use_native_writer.description: New setting to use the native ClickHouse writer for the Arrow and ArrowStream formats instead of the Apache Arrow library.

output_format_arrow_use_signed_indexes_f.description: Use signed indexes type for Arrow dictionaries by default as it's recommended

output_format_avro_confluent_subject.description: New setting to specify the subject name for schema registration in Confluent Schema Registry when writing AvroConfluent output.

output_format_binary_encode_types_in_bin.description: Added new setting to allow to write type names in binary format in RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes output format

output_format_binary_write_json_as_strin.description: Add new setting to write values of JSON type as JSON string in RowBinary output format

output_format_compression_level.description: Allow to change compression level in the query output

output_format_compression_zstd_window_lo.description: Allow to change zstd window log in the query output when zstd compression is used

output_format_csv_serialize_tuple_into_s.description: A new way of how interpret tuples in CSV format was added.

output_format_decimal_trailing_zeros.description: Do not output trailing zeros in text representation of Decimal types by default for better looking output

output_format_float_precision.description: A new setting to control decimal digits in float output

output_format_image_height.description: New setting controlling the height of the output image for image output formats such as PNG.

output_format_image_streaming_animation.description: New setting controlling whether image output formats such as PNG write each frame of an animation as soon as the next value of t is seen, instead of buffering all the frames in memory.

output_format_image_terminal_mode.description: New setting controlling whether image output formats such as PNG are rendered directly to the terminal using an inline image protocol.

output_format_image_time_divisor_seconds.description: New setting controlling the denominator of the time unit of the t column, which makes image output formats such as PNG produce an animation.

output_format_image_time_multiplier_seco.description: New setting controlling the numerator of the time unit of the t column, which makes image output formats such as PNG produce an animation.

output_format_image_width.description: New setting controlling the width of the output image for image output formats such as PNG.

output_format_json_named_tuples_as_objec.description: Allow to serialize named tuples as JSON objects in JSON formats by default

output_format_json_pretty_print.description: Print values in a pretty format in JSON output format by default

output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers.description: Disable quoting of the 64 bit integers in JSON by default

output_format_native_encode_types_in_bin.description: Added new setting to allow to write type names in binary format in Native output format

output_format_native_use_flattened_dynam.description: Add flattened Dynamic/JSON serializations to Native format

output_format_native_write_json_as_strin.description: Add new setting to allow write JSON column as single String column in Native format

output_format_orc_compression_method.description: Use lz4 compression in ORC output format by default

output_format_orc_dictionary_key_size_th.description: For a string column in ORC output format, if the number of distinct values is greater than this fraction of the total number of non-null rows, turn off dictionary encoding.

output_format_orc_string_as_string.description: ClickHouse allows arbitrary binary data in the String data type, which is typically UTF-8.

output_format_orc_writer_time_zone_name.description: The time zone name for ORC writer, the default ORC writer's time zone is GMT.

output_format_parquet_compliant_nested_t.description: Change an internal field name in output Parquet file schema.

output_format_parquet_compression_method.description: Use lz4 compression in Parquet output format by default

output_format_parquet_date_as_uint16.description: Write Date as Date32 instead of plain UInt16 (these are the two Parquet types closest to Date).

output_format_parquet_datetime_as_uint32.description: Write DateTime as DateTime64(3) instead of UInt32 (these are the two Parquet types closest to DateTime).

output_format_parquet_enum_as_byte_array.description: Write enum using parquet physical type: BYTE_ARRAY and logical type: ENUM

output_format_parquet_fixed_string_as_fi.description: Use Parquet FIXED_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY type for FixedString by default

output_format_parquet_geometadata.description: A new setting to allow to write information about geo columns in parquet metadata and encode columns in WKB format.

output_format_parquet_string_as_string.description: ClickHouse allows arbitrary binary data in the String data type, which is typically UTF-8.

output_format_parquet_unsupported_types_.description: New setting to convert unsupported CH types to parquet (arrow) binary instead of UNKNOWN_TYPE exception.

output_format_parquet_version.description: Use latest Parquet format version for output format

output_format_parquet_wide_integer_as_de.description: New setting to write Int128, UInt128, Int256, and UInt256 values as standard Parquet DECIMAL values.

output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter.description: Added support for writing Parquet bloom filters.

output_format_parquet_write_page_index.description: Add a possibility to write page index into parquet files.

output_format_pretty_color.description: Setting is changed to allow also for auto value, disabling ANSI escapes if output is not a tty

output_format_pretty_display_footer_colu.description: Add a setting to display column names in the footer if there are many rows.
Add a setting to control the threshold value for setting output_format_pretty_display_footer_column_names_min_rows.

output_format_pretty_glue_chunks.description: A new setting to make Pretty formats prettier.

output_format_pretty_highlight_digit_gro.description: If enabled and if output is a terminal, highlight every digit corresponding to the number of thousands, millions, etc.

output_format_pretty_max_rows.description: It is better for usability - less amount to scroll.

output_format_pretty_max_value_width_app.description: Single values in Pretty formats won't be cut.

output_format_pretty_named_tuples_as_jso.description: New setting to control whether named tuples in Pretty format are output as JSON objects

output_format_pretty_single_large_number.description: Print a readable number tip on the right side of the table if the block consists of a single number which exceeds this value (except 0)

output_format_trim_fixed_string.description: New setting to trim trailing zero bytes from FixedString values in text output formats

output_format_values_escape_quote_with_q.description: If true escape ' with '', otherwise quoted with \'

page.description: Sets the page number for paginated results.

page_cache_block_size.description: Size of file chunks to store in the userspace page cache, in bytes.

page_cache_inject_eviction.description: Userspace page cache will sometimes invalidate some pages at random.

page_cache_lookahead_blocks.description: On userspace page cache miss, read up to this many consecutive blocks at once from the underlying storage, if they're also not in the cache.

page_cache_max_coalesced_bytes.description: When readBigAt populates the userspace page cache, consecutive cache misses are coalesced into a single read from the underlying storage.

paimon_target_snapshot_id.description: Query-level targeted snapshot read for Paimon incremental mode.

parallel_hash_join_threshold.description: When hash-based join algorithm is applied, this threshold helps to decide between using hash and parallel_hash (only if estimation of the right table size is available).

parallel_non_joined_rows_processing.description: Allow multiple threads to process non-joined rows from the right table in parallel during RIGHT and FULL JOINs.

parallel_replicas_allow_in_with_subquery.description: If true, subquery for IN will be executed on every follower replica.

parallel_replicas_allow_materialized_vie.description: Allow usage of materialized views with parallel replicas

parallel_replicas_allow_merge_tables.description: Allow reading from a Merge table with parallel replicas.

parallel_replicas_allow_view_over_merget.description: Allow parallel replicas to execute the outer query of a simple view over MergeTree tables (instead of the view's inner query), improving parallelization across nodes.

parallel_replicas_connect_timeout_ms.description: The timeout in milliseconds for connecting to a remote replica during query execution with parallel replicas.

parallel_replicas_count.description: This is internal setting that should not be used directly and represents an implementation detail of the 'parallel replicas' mode.

parallel_replicas_custom_key.description: An arbitrary integer expression that can be used to split work between replicas for a specific table.

parallel_replicas_custom_key_range_lower.description: Allows the filter type range to split the work evenly between replicas based on the custom range [parallel_replicas_custom_key_range_lower, INT_MAX].

parallel_replicas_custom_key_range_upper.description: Allows the filter type range to split the work evenly between replicas based on the custom range [0, parallel_replicas_custom_key_range_upper].

vector_search_with_rescoring.description: If ClickHouse performs rescoring for queries that use the vector similarity index.

wait_for_part_commit_in_dependent_materi.description: Controls whether each sink commits its just-written part before its own dependent materialized view cascade runs, so a cascade that reads back from the source via JOIN observes the part written by that sink.

webassembly_udf_max_fuel.description: Fuel limit per WebAssembly UDF instance execution.

webassembly_udf_max_input_block_size.description: Maximum number of rows passed to a WebAssembly UDF in a single block.

webassembly_udf_max_instances.description: Maximum number of WebAssembly UDF instances that can run in parallel per function.

webassembly_udf_max_memory.description: Memory limit in bytes per WebAssembly UDF instance.

write_full_path_in_iceberg_metadata.description: Write full paths (including s3://) into iceberg metadata files.

write_through_distributed_cache_buffer_s.description: Only has an effect in ClickHouse Cloud.
